location.label: Location
location.toolTip: Region for the deployment; use the same region as the existing resource group (typically).

basics.name: rgName
basics.label: Resource group name (must already exist)
basics.toolTip: Enter the name of an existing resource group in this subscription. This template does not create a resource group.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 1–90 characters. Allowed: letters, digits, period, underscore, hyphen, parentheses. Name cannot end with a period (Azure naming rules).

basics.name: deployLighthouse
basics.label: Deploy Azure Lighthouse (BlueVoyant MSSP onboarding)?
basics.toolTip: Onboards this resource group to Azure Lighthouse with BlueVoyant’s standard authorizations. Turn off to skip.

basics.name: deployGdapPermissions
basics.label: Deploy partner resource group RBAC (gdap-permissions template)?
basics.toolTip: Applies the linked Azure RBAC role assignments in gdap-permissions.json to this resource group. Granular Delegated Admin Privileges (GDAP) is set up in Partner Center / Microsoft Entra admin relationships—not by this box—but this template is often used together with Lighthouse and GDAP for a full partner setup. Prerequisite: partner Entra group object IDs must exist in your directory or assignments will fail.
